title: bonafousia muelleriana
intro: Bonafousia muelleriana, commonly known as the Yellow Bells or Yellow Trumpet, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family, native to tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion, due to its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Bonafousia muelleriana include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and cardiotonic effects, which can help in alleviating conditions such as anxiety, asthma, and cardiac issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
